newsitem.title: USA: US Midco refined products mixed, tracking futures.
newsitem.headline: US Midco refined products mixed, tracking futures.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel and unleaded gasoline prices were mixed on Thursday, tracking NYMEX front-month futures on unchanged differentials, traders said.
Diesel and gasoline basis held onto gains fueled by refiner buying in the Gulf Coast spot market that rippled into the Midwest in the form of higher differentials, traders said.

But traders questioned whether the buying interest in the Gulf Coast would continue to prop up Midwest basis. "We're just kind of drifting along now. I suspect we're going to turn lower," one Midwest trader said.
Midwest refineries were operating at 94.7 percent of capacity last week on crude runs down an average 60,000 barrels per day, injecting some bullish sentiment into a regional market awash in product.
Unleaded gasoline for January deliveries was steady at 1.50/1.25 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in Group Three and 1.25/1.0 cents under the print in Chicago, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel remained bid 1.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil in Group Three and 3.50/3.25 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago.
High sulphur diesel was unchanged at bids 5.75 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 4.50 cents under the print in Chicago, traders said.
